column1: # Game profile of Scott Pilgrim EX (Switch, update 1.0.0.13755, v65536). This fork's; brought up from MARVEL Cosmic Invasion's profile (010059D020C26000, the same developer and engine)
# FNA (XNA 4 reimplemented in C#) compiled with .NET NativeAOT, SDL 3, FAudio, SDK 20.5.17. Epic Online Services comes as an NRO (nro/EOSSDK-Switch-Shipping.nro), which the host
# refuses as an online SDK: the EOS calls main imports are answered offline (dm/host/fork_eos_offline.c).
# Rendering: as MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, FNA3D draws through SDL_GPU on Vulkan on the console (subsdk0, NintendoSDK_Vulkan) and falls back to its OpenGL driver on the hosts. The
# driver's code in main is MARVEL Cosmic Invasion's instruction for instruction (only the PC-relative words differ), 0x8f30 bytes further on: patches.py makes it ask for an OpenGL
# ES 3 context and hands the host the renderer, android.tsv turns on the host's run of the driver's command list (DM_FNA3D_GL_PUMP)
# The control data has the English name only
# The game ships Korean text (Content/Global/Loc/Korean.zpbn) but its control data lists no ko: porter --language ko is allowed
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_Vulkan), subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL)
# The NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: the game maps its memory itself in address regions of the alias region.
# As in MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, nninitStartup (main+0x14f0) takes StandardAllocator::Initialize(nullptr, 40 GB: main+0xf8b10 returns 0xa00000000) and the .NET GC then asks
# AllocateAddressRegion for 20 GB more (0x500000000): the provisional profile's 4.375 GB alias region refused that and the game aborted through nn::diag 0.3 s after start
# (Retroid Pocket Nova). MARVEL Cosmic Invasion's block: 256 MB in front + a 64 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region. The SDK's address region manager
# has its node area cut (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py, sdk 0023a1b0…, already there for FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE)
# (the game compiles GLSL that MojoShader writes at run time: nothing is translated ahead)
